channel.title: Arrangements on Hsing-An Lee
channel.description: Hsing-An Lee is a recorder player and composer.

item.title: hazy
item.description:
This work was completed with classmates from a university elective course, using alternative electronic music as its stylistic direction.
The piece takes a synth bass as its central motive, exploring the flow and suspension of the music.
It describes the boundary between &ldquo;hazy&rdquo; and &ldquo;clear&rdquo; through sound.
Credit: Lyrics: Pei-Yu Lin, He-Hsin Wu, Yu-An Liu Composer: Hsing-An Lee, Pei-Yu Lin, He-Hsin Wu Arrangement: Hsing-An Lee Vocals: Hsing-An Lee, Pei-Yu Lin, He-Hsin Wu

item.title: Artisan Nova
item.description: This work was selected as the official station-entry music for Taichung MRT Shui-an Temple Station. The station is connected to a Taiwanese Daoist temple; after leaving the platform, one can see red lanterns and the nearby Shui-an Temple. We decided to sample folk-like melodies from traditional bayin music, combining guzheng and suona-like timbres with a relaxed Bossa Nova accompaniment, adding a touch of temple culture to the modern urban setting.
item.content:encoded:
This work was selected as the official station-entry music for Taichung MRT Shui-an Temple Station.

The station is connected to a Taiwanese Daoist temple; after leaving the platform, one can see red lanterns and the nearby Shui-an Temple. We decided to sample folk-like melodies from traditional bayin music, combining guzheng and suona-like timbres with a relaxed Bossa Nova accompaniment, adding a touch of temple culture to the modern urban setting.

The suona-like sound was sampled by us directly at a temple, which became one of the small details of the work.

 Composer: Hsing-An Lee, Yu-Lin Chen
